text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've cast away all my hesitation! I'll 
blow past even Sweep-san! ...With 
wholehearted sincerity, of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll leap right out of the paddock if I 
have to! And then I shall declare to all 
my fans: I will shine brighter than ever 
before!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And to all the "Princesses" fighting 
alongside me! Will you be able to 
withstand my Princess☆Suplex, I wonder!?
